editorial:
Imagine waking up in a town where everyone thinks you are a cold-blooded killer. That is exactly what happens to Deena and her friends. You get thrown right into the middle of a 90s nightmare filled with neon colors, baggy clothes, and a lot of blood. The vibe feels like a mix of a classic slasher flick and a teen drama. You will quickly find yourself rooting for this group of misfits as they try to figure out why their town is cursed and who is actually pulling the strings behind the scenes.

The best part is how the movie keeps you guessing with some really wild twists. The acting is solid, and the pacing never slows down, so you won't find yourself getting bored. While some of the kills are a bit over the top, it just adds to the fun. If you love scary movies that don't take themselves too seriously, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Netflix to see all the gore in detail, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want a physical copy for your shelf.
endingExplained: You find out that the curse is tied to a woman named Sarah Fier. Deena and her friends realize they have to stop the cycle of killing to break the spell. In the final fight, they manage to defeat the evil force and save the town. The movie ends with the survivors finally finding peace, though they know the history of their town is much darker than they ever imagined before.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s nostalgia and slasher movies.
